copy.name: The wooded approach
copy.subtitle: Campaign-scale terrain & army motion
copy.scope: A staged landscape for comparing the visual direction. Route following and woodland emergence are illustrative; your campaign is unchanged.
copy.controls: Drag to orbit · Scroll / pinch to zoom · Shift-drag to pan · Space to pause · Esc to return
copy.contact: 03  /  A force emerges from the trees
copy.arrival: 04  /  Formations meet at the woodland edge
copy.planning_note: The lake closes the direct line. The column takes the dry track between wet ground and the wooded slope.
copy.marching_note: The formation narrows along the bends. Soldiers follow the same ground profile as the road.
copy.contact_note: An illustrative opposing formation leaves cover and advances onto the flank. Pause or scrub to inspect the movement.
copy.arrival_note: The preview stops at contact. Individual battles and new ambush rules are outside this study.
copy.lake_note: The route follows the shoreline; the column stays on land.
copy.marsh_note: Pools, reeds and mud distinguish the marsh from the dry road.
copy.forest_note: Dense canopy obscures the staged opposing formation until it reaches the edge.
copy.mountain_note: Exposed rock and elevation frame the narrow approach.
copy.unit_note: Illustrative Roman infantry, shield bearers and a mounted commander. Figure count is representational.
copy.comparison_note: The existing campaign remains playable. Reopen the 3D study with the button below.
